what: pistonbeach4 resumed from its 21 s state with the droplet model on (step_3d droplet_model 1, metres_per_cell 0.25, the node's SI defaults: 100 um median, spread 0.7, evaporation 1e-9 m^2/s, deletion at 1 um); the plain run's dumps untouched
cache: out/runs/pistonbeach4d/cache/full, frames 22.425 to 23.625 s with radius.####.npy

render.route: maya/render_surface_preview.ps1 (Arnold in the Maya session), frame 7 (23.625 s), 1400 x 1400, the crop camera on the splash, the ocean look

A_control_old_mist.pipeline: main at eb199af: every mist particle a 1.5-cell puff on a 1-cell grid, fog ramp, 0.08 per cell

B_droplet_clouds.pipeline: a first try that splatted the clouds into a channel named spray_density, which the Bifrost-to-Arnold path does not read: no spray rendered; kept as the record of that

B2_droplet_clouds.pipeline: a second try, the channel renamed voxel_fog_density but beside a level set in the same volume, which Arnold takes as the primary channel: still no spray; kept as the record of that

B3_droplet_clouds.pipeline: this branch: each mist particle its droplet cloud (its radius, cloud 1 cell, SURF_METRES_PER_CELL 0.25, mist_density 1: the whole parcel as droplets) splatted additively on a half-cell grid into a fog-only volume; opaque, every cloud solid to its kernel's edge

C_fraction_0.01.pipeline: as B3 with mist_density 0.01: a hundredth of the parcel's water as droplets; dense grey balls, cores still opaque

D_fraction_0.001.pipeline: as B3 with mist_density 0.001: a thousandth of the parcel; a translucent haze of puffs the splash shows through

E_fraction_0.01_cloud_2.pipeline: as C with clouds of 2 cells (SURF_MIST_RADIUS 2): the same water spread over eight times the volume; cotton-like cumulus, opaque across a cloud

smoothing_render.what: the same frame, camera, look and mist (mist_density 0.001, every escaped droplet a cloud) at 1000 x 1000; one variable: the surface smoothing. The control on 8 Arnold threads (the daytime cap), the flow arms on 32 once the machine was offered: walls not comparable across arms

env.look: as the spray arms (ocean, depth 40, colour 0.3 0.55 0.6, sun -40 160 0 at 6, sky 12, camera 505 96 -52 to 505 65 15)

A_control.knobs: SURF_SMOOTH_ITERS 1, SURF_MCF_ITERS 0: the pipeline as it was, one Gaussian pass
A_control.look: the particle lattice shows through as ripples over the whole surface; the body blobby, the splash grey puffs over the worms (8 Arnold threads, the daytime cap)

B_masked_flow.knobs: SURF_SMOOTH_ITERS 0, SURF_MCF_ITERS 30: ST-FLIP Appendix B, the flow under the self-quotient mask (sigma 2 cells, theta 2, zeta 5, dilate 1 voxel)
B_masked_flow.look: the bulk a smooth dark surface, the ripples gone; the curtain full of small bright glass beads, the lone drops and thin bits the mask keeps, inside the mist (32 threads)

C_unmasked_flow.knobs: as B with SURF_MASK_FLOOR 1: the same flow with the mask at 1 everywhere
C_unmasked_flow.look: the same smooth bulk, the beads gone, the splash grey puffs only: what the mask buys (32 threads)

mask_dilate.0: the sheet thins and the mesher drops it (0 vertices), the ball keeps 0.84
mask_dilate.1: the sheet kept (248), the ball 1.00; the block's edge and mask unchanged

droplets_in_the_render.note: a voxel deep in their own sphere: not mist by depth, not contoured by the mesher; now every droplet is mist and none is surface (the papers' split)
